name: odrick/free-tex-packer
description: Free texture packer and sprite sheet generator supporting rotation, trimming, multipacking, and export to json, xml, pixi.js, godot, phaser, and cocos2d formats.
score_rationale: Popular sprite atlas tool with 1.2k stars and broad engine export support, though it is no longer actively maintained as of 2021.
summary: Multi-format sprite atlas packer with rotation and trim for game engines
